explains: The head branch scenario/s16-no-merge-base is an orphan: its history shares no commit with main, so git merge-base finds nothing and there is no pre-change version of any file to compare against. The only honest result is the incompleteness pre_change_unavailable, blocking, naming the head ref. Everything that needs the pre-change file is therefore not computed: a client URL constant that exists on main but not at the head (the head endpoints.ts has no AUDIT_LOG_URL and no SETTLEMENT_SUMMARY_URL; these are constants of the web client, the routes themselves live in acme/api, which this change does not touch) must not be reported as a removed route still called, and parseLegacyDate (exported on main, absent at the head) must not be reported as a removed symbol or used for named-export narrowing. Comparing the two trees as if they were a change would produce 90 changed files and invented removals. The rewritten tree also has no file that matches the configured routes_glob (src/modules/*/routes.tsx), and with no pre-change version it cannot be said that one was deleted, so that is the blocking routes_unmatched: no screen is claimed, and none is said to be absent.

must_exclude.why: removed routes are computed against the pre-change version, which does not exist
parseLegacyDate is missing at the head only because the history is unrelated; narrowing and removals are not computed
